no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA received a priority review under PDUFA V and was not presented at the Antiviral Products Advisory Committee because LDV/SOF received breakthrough designation and the benefit/risk assessment did not appear controversial based on the review team's preliminary assessment of the top line trial results.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for HARVONI (ledipasvir/sofosbuvir, NDA 205834). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states the application was not presented at the Antiviral Products Advisory Committee because LDV/SOF had breakthrough therapy designation and its benefit/risk assessment did not appear controversial; the Office Director memo likewise confirms there were no safety, efficacy, or trial-design issues warranting an AC meeting. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
